description: This is the entry point of a React application, setting up the root rendering of the React component tree into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS, and the main App component, and initiates the rendering inside a strict mode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the component tree into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
